text:
sofia: dropping a quick prototype for alerting UI tweaks 11 - main ideas: editable threshold chips inline, a compact 'notification preview' drawer, and a suppression inspector that shows "which rules would be silenced" for a given time window
omar: nice. quick UX Q: when a user edits a threshold, do we validate immediately or wait for Save?
jules: strong prefer explicit Save. thresholds are dangerous to change accidentally. keyboard shortcuts would speed things (Enter=save, Esc=cancel)
miranda: also add a tiny audit hint: show last-changed-by + timestamp on hover. helps on calls
a11y-bot: accessibility notes: inline chips must be focusable via tab order. use role="button" with aria-pressed for toggles. For the editor: announce the current aggregation and unit, e.g., "Editing threshold: 95th over 5m, currently 72%"
sofia: good. thinking to surface the aggregation calc in small muted text beneath the chip so users see the "why"
omar: on the preview drawer: can we show both the canonical delivery (primary channel) and fallback channel side-by-side? helps debug routing logic when primary fails
jules: yes, show a mini card: Primary: Email -> example payload, Fallback: Slack -> example payload. include an expand arrow for raw JSON
miranda: suppression inspector idea: choose a sample time or use "now" and highlight which active rules suppress a match. color + icon for each suppression policy and a reason label (eg: "scheduled maintenance")
a11y-bot: color contrast reminder: markers must meet 4.5:1. also do not rely on color alone 1 add textual reason and a small symbol (slash icon)
ops-bot: checklist for eng: add unit tests for serialization of suppression windows, e2e that opens preview drawer, and keyboard navigation smoke test
sofia: microcopy candidates: "Suppress for" vs "Silence for" vs "Mute for". leaning to "Mute notifications for" since it's clear and temporal
omar: "Mute" is fine. doc writers will add a tooltip explaining immutability vs soft mute
jules: tiny layout nit: in narrow view, collapse the preview drawer into an overlay not a side pane so threshold rows stay readable
miranda: also add a "last triggered" column to rules list. low effort and immediate value for debugging stale rules
sofia: action items: 1) sofia update figma with inline chips + save/cancel + unsaved dot 2) a11y-bot to write acceptance criteria (aria text examples + NVDA notes) 3) omar to spec preview dual-channel cards + JSON expand 4) jules to prototype mobile overlay behavior
a11y-bot: I'll drop the ARIA snippets here later and attach a sample screenreader script
omar: I'll include sample payloads with redacted fields for privacy
sofia: thanks all :thumbsup: planning to show this at Friday's design review. flag anything else now or DM me
